name: Design Twin — Design Export for AI

networkAccess.reasoning: Loopback only. The plugin connects to a WebSocket bridge the user runs on their own machine (the open-source figma-pull CLI / designtwin MCP server) to hand design data to their local coding agent. No internet domain is listed and none is reachable: design data never leaves the user's computer. Three ports are declared only so the bridge can fall back if 8787 is taken.
